title: Done round 11: pro agent, flows + new tools
brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "luis". Basic-flow check of our own demo app (localhost, simulated PayPal, demo accounts). HTTP only — no browser tools.
You are the agent of Luis Ortega, a plumber (ZIP 78721, TSBPE licence M-41877, PayPal <email>). Key and onboarding link: <dir>/luis-token.json. Start at http://localhost:8810/llms.txt (pro side, A2A). Onboard Luis over HTTP (PIN <pin> for his person steps only; verify PayPal; add the licence number; set weekly hours 8–6 Mon–Sat), then win one plumbing job (offer visit times if asked), do it and get paid: BEFORE photo, AFTER photos for each condition (respect timed conditions by waiting on the platform clock), a note, and a parts receipt only if asked. Camera: `node <dir>/camera.mjs <faucet-installed|sink-dry|valve-worn> <out.jpg> <lat> <lng>` (job location; save under <dir>/photos/luis/). Receipt: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:/paypal/done/api/demo-assets/make-assets.ps1 -Receipt <out.jpg> -Date MM/DD/YYYY -Store "LUIS PARTS <random 4 letters>"` (a store name unique to you). If a photo goes to a person, ask_for_review and wait. Afterwards: my_dashboard and my_work_record — do the numbers match what you earned? verify the record (POST /api/work-record/verify). Report to <dir>/reports/luis.md: hired? paid? amounts, payout status, the dashboard/record results, anything that failed or confused you. Under ~70 tool calls.

Done & Paid hires local pros for your person and pays them only when the work is done. You act for one person (whoami).

## Connecting (a pro's agent)

- A2A only: POST http://localhost:8810/a2a with Authorization: Bearer dpk_... (staff issue the key, or the pro makes one on the
  website). Actions and their arguments:
  - whoami {  }: your pro record
  - my_profile {  }: your profile, badges, readiness and jobs
  - readiness {  }: what blocks being hired and the website link your person opens to fix it
  - list_jobs { since? (ISO, the newest created you've seen), radius? (miles) }: every open job in your trade within your service radius, newest first (ZIP and miles only)
  - wait_for_news { after? (event id), seconds? (1-50), since? }: waits for news: new jobs in your feed, counters, hires, change answers, check results, payouts
  - set_rates { callout?, hourly?, perMile? (USD), freeMiles?, radius? (miles), lead? (hours), rush?, floor?, crew?, partsPolicy?: at_cost|markup_10|included }: your rates and service radius
  - job_status { job }: one job (your own offers only)
  - scope_reply { job, text }: your words on the scope before agreeing; reviewed for gaps

  - counter { offer, amount (USD), parts?, partsPolicy? }: answer the customer's counter once
  - accept { offer }: accept the customer's counter
  - decline { offer }: decline the counter
  - withdraw_offer { offer }: withdraw your open offer
  - withdraw_change { job, change }: withdraw a change order the customer hasn't answered
  - request_materials_advance { job, change, items, supplierEmail? }: after an approved materials change order: the supplier's invoice + a photo on site; paid now when the checks pass
  - return_materials { job, change, amount (USD), note? }: materials returned unused: they come off the final payment
